<DESCRIPTION>TRANSITION SERVICES AGREEMENT
<TEXT>
<html><head><title>ilxp_ex105.htm</title><!--Document created using EDGARMaster--></head><body style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; FONT: 10pt times new roman; MARGIN-LEFT: 7%; MARGIN-RIGHT: 7%"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:right;"><strong>EXHIBIT 10.5</strong></p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:right;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:center;"><strong>TRANSITION SERVICES AGREEMENT</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">This Transition Services Agreement (this &#8220;<strong>Agreement</strong>&#8221;) is entered into as of October 23, 2026 (the &#8220;<strong>Effective Date</strong>&#8221;), by and between Ecominas Corp., a Nevada corporation (the &#8220;<strong>Company</strong>&#8221;), and Andrew Gaudet (&#8220;<strong>Mr. Gaudet</strong>&#8221;).</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:center;"><strong>RECITALS</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">The Company has completed an asset-only acquisition of certain PetrolleumAI technology from Franklin Mar&#237;n Toro and has appointed Mr. Mar&#237;n Toro as Chief Executive Officer and President and as a director, effective at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026, Ricardo Enrique Silva Canelon has resigned from his officer positions as of that time and continues as a director and Chairman of the Board. Mr. Gaudet will remain Chief Operating Officer and a director for a short handover period. The parties wish to record Mr. Gaudet&#8217;s transition responsibilities without making any future resignation automatically effective.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>1. TRANSITION PERIOD</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Mr. Gaudet will provide transition services beginning on the Effective Date and ending on a mutually agreed completion date, expected to be approximately fourteen (14) to twenty-one (21) calendar days after the Effective Date, or such earlier or later date as the parties agree in writing (the &#8220;<strong>Transition Period</strong>&#8221;). No resignation date is fixed by this Agreement.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>2. CONTINUED OFFICES AND AUTHORITY</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">During the Transition Period, Mr. Gaudet will continue to hold his existing offices as Chief Operating Officer and director unless and until he validly resigns or is removed in accordance with applicable law and the Company&#8217;s governing documents. He will act within the authority granted by the Board and coordinate with the Chief Executive Officer. This Agreement does not appoint any director, accept any resignation or delegate authority reserved to the Board.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>3. TRANSITION RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="margin:0px"> <table style="border-spacing:0;text-align:left;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"> <tr style="height:15px"> <td style="width:4%;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="width:4%;vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;">Coordinate introductions and an orderly handover to the Chief Executive Officer of the Company&#8217;s relationships with its transfer agent, EDGAR filing agent, legal counsel, accountants and auditors, and OTC Markets Group.</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;">Deliver or arrange reasonable access to the Company&#8217;s corporate books, minute books, material agreements, asset records, financial and operational information, service-provider correspondence and pending-action lists.</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">Assist in identifying open items for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and the related Form 10-Q, including information needed by the Company&#8217;s accountant, auditor and counsel, without assuming responsibility for work beyond his authority or control.</p></td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;">Provide a factual status handover regarding the Company&#8217;s existing business, assets and agreements; no disposition of any asset is authorized by this Agreement.</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;">Assist with changes of bank and authorized signatories, regulatory credentials and other controlled-access systems through secure, documented procedures, without disclosing personal passwords or circumventing security policies.</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><font style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</font></p></td> <td style="vertical-align:top;">Deliver a written handover memorandum identifying completed transfers, outstanding matters, contacts, deadlines and documents not yet available.</td></tr></table></p> <p style="margin:0px"></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:center;">Ecominas Corp. &#8212; Transition Services Agreement</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:center;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="margin:0px"> <table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"> <tr style="height:15px"> <td class="hpbhr">&nbsp;</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: black 1px solid; TEXT-INDENT: 0px;text-align:center;">1</td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td><p style='page-break-after: always'></p></td></tr> <tr style="height:15px"> <td>&nbsp;</td></tr></table></p> <p style="margin:0px"></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>4. STANDARD OF PERFORMANCE</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Mr. Gaudet will perform the services reasonably, in good faith and with due care, subject to lawful Board direction. He gives no warranty as to future commercial outcomes, the accuracy of materials supplied by others or the completion of third-party tasks, and will promptly notify the Chief Executive Officer and the Board of any material obstacle to the handover.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>5. COMPENSATION AND EXPENSES</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Mr. Gaudet will receive no additional compensation for the transition services. The Company will reimburse reasonable, pre-approved and documented out-of-pocket expenses in accordance with Company policy. This Agreement does not issue, cancel, transfer, vest or repurchase any securities, and Mr. Gaudet&#8217;s existing shareholdings are unaffected.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>6. CONFIDENTIALITY AND COMPANY PROPERTY</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Mr. Gaudet will keep nonpublic Company information confidential, except as required by law or reasonably necessary for his authorized duties, and will return Company property and records in his custody at the end of the Transition Period. Nothing herein prohibits communications with governmental regulators, protected whistleblowing or disclosures required by law.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>7. RESIGNATION</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Upon completion of the transition, Mr. Gaudet intends to deliver a written resignation from his positions as Chief Operating Officer and director substantially in the form attached as Exhibit A. No resignation is delivered or made effective by the execution of this Agreement. The Company will address any resulting vacancy by separate corporate action and will report the resignation on Form 8-K as required.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>8. NO RELEASE; EXISTING RIGHTS</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">This Agreement is not a release of either party&#8217;s claims, a waiver of accrued compensation or indemnification rights, or an amendment of the Company&#8217;s charter documents. Rights to advancement, indemnification and insurance, if any, are governed by applicable law, the Company&#8217;s governing documents and separate agreements.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>9. TERMINATION</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Either party may terminate the transition services by written notice to the other. Termination of services does not by itself constitute or effect a resignation from any office. Sections 6, 8 and 10 survive termination.</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>10. MISCELLANEOUS</strong></p> <p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&nbsp;</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">This Agreement is governed by Nevada law, without giving effect to conflict-of-laws rules. Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature. If any provision is unenforceable, the remainder continues in effect.</p> <p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p> <p
